# Jesus Walks on the Water (Matthew 14:29)

## Emotional Focus
When you feel like you’re sinking and need Jesus’ hand.

## Key KJV
“And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water.” (Matthew 14:29)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus walked on the water to His friends. Peter stepped out but began to sink. Jesus reached out and caught him right away.

## Coloring Prompt
Peter walking on the water toward Jesus with Jesus’ hand reaching out in the moonlight.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Keep your eyes on Jesus and He will hold you up.”
